why_relevant: Consumer-finance outlet that reliably republishes and summarises new CZ salary surveys including banker pay ('Kolik bere ajťák, prodavač, bankéř'). Cheap ungated proxy when the recruiter PDF is gated.

Business daily press-release channel where recruiter and bank-sponsored labour surveys land (observed: J&T Banka Business Report 2026 on talent shortage, 58% of firms citing recruitment/retention as a key problem).

Niche CZ trade site that publishes a monthly tally of financial-adviser/tied-agent moves between networks ('Přechody poradců v červenci 2026: slabší nábory a čištění řad'). Closest thing to a monthly hiring/attrition index for the CZ distribution side of banking and insurance — a genuine weak-signal, low-competition source.

source_name: TalentUp — Czech Republic salary benchmark report
why_relevant: Free CZ benchmark covering 110+ roles across 12 departments incl. Finance, banded by seniority and company type; a non-recruiter cross-check on recruiter-published bands.

source_name: Jobs.cz — Bankovnictví a finanční služby (sector listing)
why_relevant: Dominant CZ job board; its banking/financial-services category is the single densest stream of CZ bank vacancies. Role-title bursts (platební styk, AML, transformace, instant payments) are the earliest signal of new units or programmes before any press release.
KB's white-label Jobs.cz career site lists every open role with team/unit naming. Unit names in ads expose org structure (e.g. new payments or data units) ahead of formal announcements.
ČSOB (KBC group) open roles; largest CZ banking group by assets — hiring waves in payments/digital reveal programme starts.
RB CZ absorbed Equa bank; post-integration org changes visible through role churn and newly named departments in ads.
Cross-border CZ&SK entity; ads reveal which functions sit in Prague vs Bratislava vs group hubs — a structural signal about centralisation.
MONETA runs both a jobs.cz-hosted board and its own kariera.moneta.cz; dual publication means role text and employer-branding content (unit descriptions) to mine for structure.
Largest CZ retail bank (Erste group). Its own-domain career site carries narrative sections about tribes/chapters and transformation programmes — richer org signal than a bare listing.
PPF-group digital bank; fast-moving product org, hiring is a leading indicator of new payment/product initiatives and of Home Credit/PPF reshuffles.
Newest CZ bank licence; a greenfield bank's vacancy list is effectively its org chart being built in public — highest information density per ad.
Regulator hiring reveals supervisory priorities: roles for instant payments oversight, DORA/PSD3, crypto/MiCA supervision signal where regulatory pressure is heading for the market.

Primary board for CZ startup/fintech hiring; ads carry unusually explicit tech and compliance detail (e.g. a Prague payments backend role naming C#/ASP.NET, AWS, PCI/OWASP), which discloses architecture and licensing intent of small payment players.

Sister board to Jobs.cz aimed at branch/operations roles. Branch-level hiring volume and geography is a proxy for network expansion or contraction — an org-change signal Jobs.cz's white-collar skew misses.

source_name: LinkedIn Jobs — Czech Republic banking/payments filter
why_relevant: The only board where senior/leadership CZ banking roles are posted in English, and the only one that ties a vacancy to a named hiring manager — the strongest bridge between job data and leadership-move intelligence.

source_name: Welcome to the Jungle CZ & SK
why_relevant: Employer-branding-heavy platform: company profiles include team structure, photos and interviews, giving qualitative org-structure context that plain listings lack. Operates a dedicated CZ&SK arm.
Aggregates ads from many boards and ATS systems, so it catches vacancies that never appear on Jobs.cz; per-employer views give a quick hiring-volume time series.

Leading CZ BNPL/payments fintech (Param group) publishes via a Recruitee ATS with stable, machine-readable per-department listing URLs — a template for finding other fintechs' ATS-hosted boards (recruitee/teamio/greenhouse/lever).
Foreign neobank with growing CZ presence; whether it hires CZ-located compliance/ops roles indicates whether it is building a local establishment rather than passporting.

source_name: Úřad práce ČR vacancy register (via Kurzy.cz company view)
why_relevant: State labour-office vacancy register is a legally-mandated, structured disclosure per employer (IČO-keyed) — the only job source with official provenance, useful for cross-checking board-derived hiring counts.
Aggregator with per-company (legal-entity-named) pages, convenient for entity-level hiring history on smaller payment institutions that lack their own career site.

source_name: VímVíc.cz — employer profiles and branch vacancies
why_relevant: Career-content site with per-bank profile pages including branch-level vacancies and employee-facing content; useful for detecting retail-network staffing changes.
English-language board used for internationally-staffed roles; when a CZ bank or hub posts here it signals a role intended for a global talent pool, often a new competence/shared-service centre.

source_name: Glassdoor — Czech Republic job and employer pages
why_relevant: Pairs vacancies with employee reviews and salary data; review text frequently discloses reorganisations, layoffs and management changes that never reach press releases.
Early-stage fintech hiring, often before a company has a website or licence; useful for detecting new CZ payment startups at formation stage.

POINTER: nearly every large CZ bank runs its career site as a branded subdomain of jobs.cz (kb., csob., rb., unicreditbank., moneta.). Enumerating <bankname>.jobs.cz is a reliable discovery heuristic for any CZ employer's official vacancy feed, including banks not yet in scope.

source_name: Workello guide: job boards in the Czech Republic
why_relevant: POINTER: recruiter-facing inventory of CZ job boards; a cheap way to enumerate boards beyond the obvious five and to understand each board's audience segment.

Employer page aggregates employee-advocacy reposts, welcome posts for new hires and internal promotions; the 'People' tab exposes headcount trend and role distribution, which is the cheapest proxy for organization change at the largest CZ retail bank.
